headline: Reliable drawing, stable zoom
summary: Draw and erase confidently on copied images, undo instantly, and keep every stroke visible while zooming even on image-heavy boards.

new.title: Direct drawing shortcuts
new.description: Press D to activate the pen or E to activate the eraser, even when drawing mode is not already open.

improved.title: Smoother image-heavy boards
improved.description: Zooming through boards with 100 or more images stays sharp and stable without severe blur jumps.

fixed.title: Independent drawing on copied images
fixed.description: Painting or erasing a duplicated or pasted image no longer changes the original image or its other copies.

fixed.title: Reliable drawing undo and redo
fixed.description: Ctrl+Z and redo now update the visible painted pixels immediately instead of leaving a stale stroke on the board.

fixed.title: Paint stays visible while zooming
fixed.description: New strokes no longer disappear or flicker when the image switches between proxy, detail, and full-resolution rendering.

fixed.title: Safe interrupted strokes
fixed.description: Pointer cancellation, window focus changes, and drawing-mode exit now finalize strokes without leaving drawing stuck.
